title: VLAN Configuration on a Switch
description: Create VLANs on a Cisco switch, name them, and assign switch ports to the correct VLANs. This is the foundational skill for network segmentation covered in the CCNA Network Access domain.
scenario: You are configuring a Layer 2 switch for an office. Three departments need network isolation: Sales (VLAN 10), Engineering (VLAN 20), and Management (VLAN 99). FastEthernet0/1 through 0/5 will serve Sales, Fa0/6 through 0/10 for Engineering, and Fa0/24 for Management access.

tasks.description: Set the switch hostname to SW1
Create VLAN 10 and name it SALES
tasks.hint: In config mode: vlan 10 → name SALES

tasks.description: Create VLAN 20 and name it ENGINEERING
tasks.hint: In config mode: vlan 20 → name ENGINEERING

tasks.description: Create VLAN 99 and name it MANAGEMENT
tasks.hint: In config mode: vlan 99 → name MANAGEMENT

tasks.description: Assign FastEthernet0/1 to VLAN 10 in access mode
tasks.hint: interface FastEthernet0/1 → switchport mode access → switchport access vlan 10

check.description: Fa0/1 must be in access VLAN 10

tasks.description: Assign FastEthernet0/6 to VLAN 20 in access mode
tasks.hint: interface FastEthernet0/6 → switchport mode access → switchport access vlan 20

check.description: Fa0/6 must be in access VLAN 20

tasks.description: Assign FastEthernet0/24 to VLAN 99 in access mode
tasks.hint: interface FastEthernet0/24 → switchport mode access → switchport access vlan 99

check.description: Fa0/24 must be in access VLAN 99
